arXiv:2608.26260v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We show that a magnet can remain perfectly collinear while its quantum vacuum circulates. Gauge-irremovable frustration therefore survives despite classical collinearity: it exists entirely in the quantum correlations. 👤 James Zou
Scientific discovery often requires many cycles of proposing, testing, and refining candidate solutions.
